title: Concept: Predictable identifier via uniqid (php) — review required
description: In php, uniqid builds an identifier from time and a counter rather than from a random source. An attacker who can approximate the time and observe one value can predict neighbours, and concurrent calls can collide. Security tokens need random_bytes.
applicability: php code that mints identifiers for tokens, links or sessions; lexical scope.
risk: Predictable identifiers and collisions; LOW severity.
